story_text:
## Cool Gadgets Review
## The Problem
## Your tracker tells you how you slept. It doesn’t help you sleep better tonight.
Sleep trackers tell you what went wrong. They don't change what happens during the night. And traditional earbuds? They're bulky, uncomfortable for side-sleepers, and can fall out before midnight. For Me Buds 2 responds in real time, stays comfortable through the night, and helps create a better sleep experience.
## The Solution
## Heartbeat sensing. Adaptive binaural sound.
For Me Buds 2 uses a micro PPG sensor to sense your nighttime rhythm from your ear. Your heart rhythm and movement help indicate how relaxed or restless your body may be before sleep.
Based on this signal, For Me Buds 2 adjusts dynamic binaural beats and blends them with calming background sounds in real time. The result is a more natural, comfortable sound experience designed to help you relax into your sleep routine. Everything is processed on-device, so your biometric data stays with you.
## Real-time sound that responds to you.
Start Care Mode in the app, check your current state, and choose a recommended sleep sound. Then the earbuds play dynamic binaural beats and calming sleep sounds in real time - helping your body relax before sleep. After your session, review your sleep data and AI report in the app. Your biometric data stays on-device.
## Review your sleep data and AI insights
See your sleep data, snoring events, and biometric signals all in one place. Replay detected snoring sounds, track heart rate and HRV, and receive an AI-powered report that helps you better understand your sleep and improve your routine.
## Why We Built
Hear directly from our CEO about the vision behind For Me Buds 2 and how real user feedback shaped its next-generation design.
## Key Features
## 1. Your sleep data stays with you.
For Me Buds 2 analyzes your biometric signals in the earbuds, while adaptive sound and AI Sleep Chat run locally on your phone. Your sleep data and AI model stay on your phone - not on cloud servers. No account or login is required. After the initial model download, these features work offline.
No login.
No cloud processing.
No server storage.
Works offline after the initial model download.
## 2. AI Sleep Chat
Turn your sleep data into a conversation. Ask about your night and get personalized explanations based on your own recorded sleep data. AI Sleep Chat is included with For Me Buds 2: free, unlimited conversations with no subscription fee. It runs locally on your phone and works offline after the initial model download. Your conversations and sleep data are not sent to cloud servers.
No subscription.
Unlimited chats.
Offline after setup.
## 3. Slim Fit - 10.4mm. Made for side sleeping.
For Me Buds 2 is 44% slimmer than our first generation, with a low-profile shape designed to sit more naturally in your ear. Less bulk. Less pressure. More comfort through the night. So you can toss, turn, and sleep on your side with confidence.
## 4. Blocks. Cancels. Masks. Triple-layer sleep silence.
Three layers of noise control work together for a quieter night. The in-ear seal blocks noise. Hybrid ANC reduces outside sound. Adaptive sleep sound masks what remains. From ambient noise to your partner’s snoring, For Me Buds 2 helps you rest more peacefully through the night.
## 5. Private AI Snore Insights — Snoring insights stay on your phone.
See when snoring was detected and replay the moments that matter. Your phone’s microphone captures nighttime audio, and an AI model analyzes it locally on your phone. After analysis, only detected snoring clips are kept on your phone for review. Other captured audio is deleted. Your bedroom audio is not uploaded to cloud servers.
## 6. Made for Sleep. Ready for Everyday Life.
Use For Me Buds 2 just like regular Bluetooth earbuds during the day. Enjoy YouTube, Spotify, podcasts, and your favorite music anytime - and take phone calls when you need to.
## Research & Validation
## Backed by research. Shaped by real data.
Research on dynamic binaural beats behind our technology was published in SLEEP, a peer-reviewed journal by Oxford Academic. Early R&D studies also showed measurable differences in sleep onset, awake time, and total sleep duration under tested conditions. These findings helped shape the adaptive sound system in For Me Buds 2.
## Live Product Demo
Watch how For Me Buds 2 connects with the app, reads your signals, adapts sound, and presents your sleep insights in real time.
## Competitive Comparison
See how For Me Buds 2 compares across sensing, privacy, noise control, sleep insights, and price - combining in-ear PPG, private on-device AI, and premium sleep features at a more accessible Kickstarter Special price.

## Shipping & Warranty
## Worldwide Free Shipping.
We offer free shipping worldwide for all For Me Buds 2 rewards. Applicable taxes, including VAT or sales tax, may be calculated and collected separately through Kickstarter’s Pledge Manager based on your shipping location. For regions where import handling is required, we plan to ship using a DDP-style process whenever possible, so backers will not be charged hidden shipping fees by us after the campaign.
No surprise shipping charges. No hidden handling fees. Just complete your pledge, confirm your details in the Pledge Manager, and get ready for For Me Buds 2.
## Warranty
For Me Buds 2 is covered by a 2-year limited warranty from the date of purchase. If your product has a manufacturing or material defect under normal use, dbbeats will provide a free repair or replacement.
The warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse, drops, impact, liquid or water damage, unauthorized repair, modification, normal wear and tear, loss, or other user-caused damage.
Customers are responsible for the cost of shipping the defective product to our designated service location. If the product is confirmed to be covered under warranty, dbbeats will cover the shipping cost for the repaired or replacement product back to you. To request warranty service, please contact cs@dbbeats.com with your order information and a description of the issue.
## Production Readiness
## Our path from prototype to mass production.
For Me Buds 2 is progressing through prototype refinement, design validation, production testing, and pilot production as we prepare for mass production. Each stage is focused on improving comfort, performance, reliability, and manufacturing quality before delivery to our backers.
## Manufacturing & Validation
We are actively validating assembly, calibration, and quality-control processes with our manufacturing partners to ensure consistent, reliable production.
## Design & Quality Validation
From ergonomic fit studies and prototype iterations to packaging checks and pilot samples, each step is being tested and refined before mass production begins.
## Who We Are
## An LG Electronics spin-off startup built on biosignal technology.
dbbeats develops sleep-tech products based on biosignal analysis, including brainwaves, heartbeats, and movement. Our team brings together hardware engineering, biosignal sensing, acoustic technology, and app development to create products that turn body signals into meaningful user experiences.
For Me Buds 2 is our next-generation sleep earbud, combining real-time sensing, adaptive sound, all-night comfort, and private on-device AI in one compact product.
We introduced the first-generation For Me Buds at CES 2025 and continue to share our sleep-tech vision with audiences around the world. We are also preparing to participate in CES 2027, where we plan to present our latest technologies and products to the global market. From product development to global exhibitions, we are continuing to build, test, and share what comes next in sleep technology.
## Why Kickstarter
## For Me Buds began on Kickstarter.
Our first campaign was made possible by early backers who believed in our vision for better sleep technology. After delivering the first generation, we listened closely to what real users wanted most from a sleep earbud. That feedback helped shape For Me Buds 2 - a slimmer, quieter, more adaptive, and more private sleep experience.
We are returning to Kickstarter because this community understands early-stage innovation and helps creators build better products through real support and honest feedback. With your support, we can complete the final steps toward production and bring For Me Buds 2 to backers around the world.

faq.q: 1. How does For Me Buds 2 protect my privacy?
faq.a: For Me Buds 2 is designed with private on-device AI. Your biometric data is processed locally for core sleep features and is not stored on our servers. No login is required for the core sleep experience.

faq.q: 2. How long does the battery last?
faq.a: For Me Buds 2 provides up to 10 hours in Sleep Mode and up to 6 hours of audio playback with ANC enabled. The charging case can recharge the earbuds up to 6 times, helping support multiple nights of use before the case itself needs charging.

faq.q: 3. Can For Me Buds 2 help block snoring and other nighttime noise?
faq.a: Yes. For Me Buds 2 combines Hybrid ANC, passive noise isolation, and adaptive sleep sound masking to reduce disruptive nighttime sounds such as traffic, household noise, and snoring. Actual noise reduction may vary depending on fit and the surrounding environment.

faq.q: 4. Are the earbuds comfortable for side sleepers?
faq.a: For Me Buds 2 was designed specifically for nighttime wear. Each earbud has a slim 10.4 mm profile, weighs under 4 g, and uses soft ear tips and wing tips to help reduce pressure and keep the earbuds secure while you sleep.

faq.q: 5. What can I see in the For Me Buds app?
faq.a: The app lets you review sleep-related information including sleep stages, total sleep time, snoring events, heart rate, HRV, and personalized sleep insights. It also includes AI Sleep Chat, allowing you to ask questions about your sleep data and better understand your nightly patterns.

faq.q: 6. Can I use For Me Buds 2 like regular Bluetooth earbuds to listen to music?
faq.a: Yes! For Me Buds 2 works just like regular Bluetooth earbuds. You can listen to music, podcasts, audiobooks, and other audio from apps like Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music, and Audible. You can also enjoy your favorite audio while using our sleep tracking features.
